text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The final day of summer camp. I was conducting
final training with Narita Brian.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
choice_data_list: We still have time, so we're okay.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
Then, as soon as I drink some water.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Your legs are as fine as ever.
How about it—care to cross paths with me for a race?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
If I'm gonna race you,
I'd rather it be a GⅠ than a place like this.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"If we are to settle this, let it be on an official stage
where we can bring out each other's best. I want to give it my all."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. You regarded me
as a rival.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Then I shall take your feelings right now
at face value."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Become even stronger, Brian.
I see the future in you."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Watched over by Symboli Rudolf, the final day of the summer training camp came to a close.
